items.title: Show HN: Port-Light – A self-hosted dashboard to show your server's port usage
items.contentSnippet:
I make this tool, a self-hosted dashboard, to show which host ports are taken, as a traffic-light grid. All the reason because I'm a home server enthusiast, but have a chaotic and terrible memory.
It can aggregate ports from your different hosts and VPS as long as the network is reachable. And it merges three local sources into one grid: host listen tables, Docker API, and Compose files.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B is excellent, but it defaults to wildly overthinking things
Cutting RAG inference costs 6x starts with deciding what never reaches the LLM
items.contentSnippet:
Most teams building retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems for high stakes classification make the same architectural bet: Route every ambiguous case straight to the language model and trust the retrieved context to sort it out. This works fine in a demo. It falls apart the moment the system has to survive an audit, a regulator, or a compliance officer asking why a specific decision was made six months ago.

items.title: DeepSeek's top-ranked V4 Flash stumbles on real agent tasks as its prices surge
items.contentSnippet:
